text:
Priya Menon: Quick sync — I'm updating the metering + pricing docs to reflect the new tiered burst credits behavior. Need a short SDK snippet for the v2 header and a dashboard link to the 'Consumption by Tier' panel. Anyone free to review?
Alex Chen: I can take the SDK snippet. do we want curl + python examples?
Priya Menon: yes please — both. Keep curl minimal; python should show header + example of the `X-Redwood-Metering` header payload. Also add note about fallback to legacy `x-metering-legacy` for older tenants.
Jordan Lee: Heads-up: dashboard panel moved — old permalink 404s. New panel URL is https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/consumption/tiers (use that in docs). Also the panel id changed so the iframe embed snippet needs the new id.
Priya Menon: perfect — thanks Jordan. Can you paste the iframe snippet?
Jordan Lee: sure — paste this: ```<iframe src=\"https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/consumption/tiers?panelId=tz-97\" width=\"100%\" height=\"360\"></iframe>```
Samir Patel: small copy nits: where we say "burst credits are consumed at time of request" -> change to "burst credits are deducted at request completion". Also clarify that queued requests hold reservation until completion or timeout.
Priya Menon: good catch Samir, will update. Also adding an example showing how to interpret the usage rows: tokens_consumed, tier_applied, and meter_rate.
Alex Chen: SDK snippet draft — curl + python below. Please sanity check and I'll push as a small PR.
Alex Chen: ```bash
# curl example
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"X-Redwood-Metering: {\\\"client_id\\\":\\\"acme-42\\\",\\\"batch_id\\\":\\\"b-2026-03\\\"}\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/fast-gpt","input":"Summarize the docs changes."}'
```
Alex Chen: ```python
# python example (requests)
import requests
import os
headers = {
  "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
  "X-Redwood-Metering": '{"client_id":"acme-42","batch_id":"b-2026-03"}'
}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", json={"model":"rwd/fast-gpt","input":"Summarize the docs changes."}, headers=headers)
print(resp.json())
```
Priya Menon: looks good — add a one-line note below the python example about escaping quotes in some shells when copying the header.
Maria Gonzales: I'll run a quick localization check on the copy after the PR. FYI we need the Spanish string for "burst credits deducted at request completion" -> "los créditos de ráfaga se descuentan al finalizar la solicitud".
Priya Menon: awesome thanks Maria. I'll open a drafts PR: #3486 (docs/meters/pricing-snippet). Assigning Alex for snippet, Jordan for dashboard link verification, Samir for behavior wording, Maria for L10n. DocBot: can you add a reminder to the PR in 48 hours if there are no approvals?
DocBot: Reminder scheduled: will ping #docs in 48h if PR #3486 has no approvals. :robot_face:
Alex Chen: pushing the snippet in a sec. tagging @priya once done.
Priya Menon: thanks all — moving to checklist: update copy, embed iframe with new panel id, add curl+python snips, L10n, then merge. I'll follow up with the small changelog blurb for release notes.
